hook.name: PhiEthHooks
hook.description: A hook implementing a 1:1 ETH/phiEth custom swap curve that bypasses concentrated liquidity. On each swap, the hook takes the full input amount, converts it via phiEth.deposit() or phiEth.withdraw(), and settles the output directly. Liquidity additions to the pool are blocked; only ETH/phiEth pools with zero fee are permitted.
